result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. It preserves the existing termination, payment, and assignment terms. However, it is broader than necessary because termination of any single Statement of Work triggers return and deletion of all Works, Company data, and Confidential Information, potentially including materials relating to continuing Statements of Work. Requiring all Works and Confidential Information to be returned in machine-readable form may also be impractical. The scope should be limited to Customer Data and, for an SOW termination, materials relating to that SOW.
